title: Steel Bridge Repair Riveting Works
description: Steel railway bridge structural repair works are being carried out using the hot riveting method. Rivets are heated in a special furnace to the required temperature, then quickly inserted into the structural holes and formed using pneumatic and hydraulic tools. As the rivet cools, it contracts, creating an exceptionally strong and durable clamping force between the connected elements. This method is used in the restoration and repair of historic and operational steel bridge structures when it is necessary to preserve the original riveted connection system.
